column5: Ah, there you are. / Your dedicated work in my LAB / has been much appreciated. / And now, your fieldwork / assignment is about to begin.
As you know, at the heart of / my research is the relationship / between POKéMON and people...
...How they grow together / through trust, battle, / friendship... / Even evolution may be shaped / by those bonds.

But to understand this, you / need to go where they live. / The towns, forests, caves, / shorelines, and old ruins. / I am too old for fieldwork now, / but you are just the right age / for this expedition.
Now tell me for your / FIELD AIDE record.
Are you a boy or a girl?
And how do you spell / your name?
Right… / AAAAAAA.
This is my grandson. / Like you, he has been helping / with my research here in / PALLET TOWN. / His name is...
His name is AAAAAAA?
Yes. / His name is AAAAAAA. /
AAAAAAA! / KANTO is waiting beyond the LAB. / Observe carefully, learn directly, / and trust the POKéMON at your side. / Your fieldwork begins now.
AAAAAAA played with the NES. / …Okay! / It’s time to go!
MOM: …Right. / All boys leave home someday. / It said so on TV. / Oh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was / looking for you.
AAAAAAA: What, it’s only AAAAAAA? / Gramps isn’t around.
OAK: Wait! / Don’t leave yet!
OAK: It’s unsafe! / POKéMON live in tall grass. / You need your own POKéMON for / your protection. / Come with me.
AAAAAAA: Gramps! / I’m fed up with waiting!
OAK: Ah, AAAAAAA! / Good, you’re both here. / You have both helped in this LAB / for some time. / This summer, I need you as / field aides. / It is time you studied KANTO / directly, beyond the LAB.
AAAAAAA: If we’re doing fieldwork, / then we need POKéMON.

OAK: Exactly, AAAAAAA. / Fieldwork cannot be done safely / without partners of your own. / These 3 were recently sent / to me by another researcher in ALOLA. / My cousin SAMSON OAK. / They’re young, but they’re / bright, adaptable, and well suited / for fieldwork. / Choose carefully.
OAK: Make your choice.
I see! BULBASAUR is your choice. / It’s very easy to raise. / So, AAAAAAA, you want to go with / the GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?
This POKéMON is really quite / energetic!
AAAAAAA received the BULBASAUR / from PROF. OAK!
Do you want to give a nickname to / this BULBASAUR?
AAAAAAA: I’ll take this one, then!
AAAAAAA received the CHARMANDER / from PROF. OAK!
AAAAAAA: Wait, AAAAAAA! / Let’s check out our POKéMON! / Come on, I’ll take you on!
WHAT? / Unbelievable! / I picked the wrong POKéMON!
OAK: That’s enough.
OAK: Both of you, over here. / There’s something important / you need to hear before / you begin.
OAK: I have a request for you two.
On the desk here is my / invention, the POKéDEX! / It records the POKéMON you see / and catch. / It’ll help us understand how / they live across KANTO.
OAK: AAAAAAA and AAAAAAA. / Take these with you. / Record what you find and / come back wiser.
AAAAAAA received the POKéDEX / from PROF. OAK.
OAK: Seeing POKéMON is useful, / but catching them teaches you more. / Travel with them. / Battle with them. / That is how real understanding / begins. / Take these POKé BALLS with you.
AAAAAAA received five POKé BALLS!
AAAAAAA put the POKé BALLS / in the POKé BALLS.

OAK: Pay attention to how the / GYM LEADERS treat their POKéMON. / There is more to learn than / strength alone. / I also study rare POKéMON whose / instincts exceed ordinary limits. / I call them APEX POKéMON. / Listen to local accounts and / compare three in your LOGBOOK. / Together, they may reveal where / an APEX POKéMON can be found. / Be ready before you challenge one. / If you flee from its battle, / it will leave for good.
AAAAAAA: Heh. Fine by me. / I’ll be finished learning / everything worth knowing before / you’ve even caught up. / Try not to fall too far behind.
OAK: We’ll see. / Power and understanding / rarely arrive at the same time. / Off you go, then. / Your expedition begins now.
I like watching the aides from / PALLET study the grass here. / Let me see how your POKéMON / moves through it!
AAAAAAA scurried back home, protecting / the exhausted and fainted POKéMON from / further harm… /
MOM: AAAAAAA! / Welcome home. / It sounds like you had quite / an experience. / Maybe you should take a quick / rest.

MOM: Oh, good! You and your / POKéMON are looking great. / I just heard from PROF. OAK. / He said that POKéMON’s energy is / measured in HP. / If your POKéMON lose their HP, / you can restore them at any / POKéMON CENTER. / If you’re going to travel far away, / the smart TRAINER stocks up on / POTIONS at the POKéMON MART. / Make me proud, honey! / Take care!

You and your POKéMON move so well / together!
My father once told me he / ventured deep into VIRIDIAN / FOREST. / He heard the grumbling growls of / a shadowy figure lurking within.
Rumour recorded. / Compare three accounts in your / LOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON. / If you flee from its battle, / it will leave for good.

AAAAAAA: Ha! Hey, AAAAAAA. / Bet you’re heading to PEWTER! / Still thinking like a tourist, / huh? / Everyone acts like KANTO is / one straight road. / There are better leads through / DIGLETT’S CAVE, VIRIDIAN / CHANNEL, and the ferry south / of PALLET. / So, go on. / Pick the obvious road if you want. / I’ll be doing actual fieldwork.
I’m too scared to enter / VIRIDIAN FOREST. / Legends tell of the forest / coming alive and ensnaring the / wicked, never to be seen again.
Rumour updated.
VIRIDIAN FOREST

ERIKA: Oh, hello. / I came to VIRIDIAN FOREST in / search of an ENERGY ROOT. / Roots are quiet things, yet they / bind a whole garden together. / A root grown here is said to heal / because the forest shares its / strength as one family. / I am certain one can be found / somewhere nearby.
This AROMA LADY knows / VIRIDIAN FOREST well!
VIRIDIAN FOREST wins today!
The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST / are so beautiful. / They seem more vibrant and grow / in number the closer you get to / the centre of the forest. / Almost like something is drawing / them inward.
Rumour updated.

GREEEAOW!
OAK: The POKéDEX signal was / almost swallowed by the forest. / So the old stories were not just / stories. / TANGROWTH may be instinct / given root and vine.

Do what with an item?
Received the ENERGY ROOT / from CHARIZARD.Ì

ERIKA: Oh! / That ENERGY ROOT is splendid. / See how many tiny roots gather / into one strong whole? / It reminds me that families, / friends, and communities grow / best together. / If I could find one of my own, I / would gladly return to the GYM.
ERIKA! / I am so glad I found you! / And look, I found an ENERGY ROOT / on the way here. / It was tucked among other roots, / all holding the soil together.

GYM AIDE: Before you battle, / remember ERIKA uses GRASS types. / FIRE, ICE, FLYING, BUG and POISON / moves are strong against GRASS. / A second type can change that. / Watch out for status moves, too!

ERIKA: How fortunate. / That is just the lesson I hoped / this forest would offer. / Some POKéMON bloom only when / friendship has taken root. / That kind of evolution is a bond, / not merely a change in form. / Before I return, may I ask you for / a proper GYM challenge? / With my GYM GUIDE present, the / match will be official.
Very well. / Show me how friendship has helped / your POKéMON grow. / Let us begin.ÎカÀ
Oh! / I concede defeat.

ERIKA: You are remarkably strong. / This battle was witnessed, so it / shall stand as your GYM challenge. / I must confer on you the / RAINBOWBADGE. / áÎÇÀË / Ëカね / I saw trust in the way your / POKéMON stood with you. / Friendship can guide evolution / as surely as sunlight guides / a bud into bloom. / Please come to CELADON GYM. / There, I will give a reward for / the growth you have shown.
AAAAAAA received the RAINBOW KEY / from ERIKA.
AAAAAAA put the RAINBOW KEY / in the KEY ITEMS.
The RAINBOW KEY opens the / BERRY PATCH next door to / CELADON GYM. / Please feel free to pick the / berries growing there.

LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST / PEWTER CITY AHEAD
BROCK’s out in MT. MOON right now, / searching for fossils! You should / go find him there.
MT. MOON is ahead, so I’m training / on every rocky patch I can find! / Battle me!
I slipped up!
The trail gets rockier from here. / Step carefully!
You found your footing!
I tripped on a GEODUDE earlier, / but I’m not going home! / ROUTE 4 made me tougher!
I still stumbled!

Hey, watch your step. These tunnels / are unstable... but that’s where the / good finds are. / You’re not just passing through, / are you? / You’ve got that look... / like you’re searching for something. / This place is full of them- / fragments of ancient POKéMON. / One fragment on its own doesn’t / tell you much... / but combine the right ones... / ...and you might get something close / to what used to live here. / If you find a fossil around / here, show it to me. / I’d like to see what you’re made of!
AAAAAAA found one HELIX FOSSIL!
AAAAAAA put the HELIX FOSSIL / in the ITEMS.
That’s a HELIX FOSSIL! / Sharp ridges... light structure... / This belonged to something built / for speed. / Good eye. You found something / with real historical value.
BROCK gave you a / DART FOSSIL.
AAAAAAA put the DART FOSSIL / in the ITEMS.
You’ve got a good eye. / Meet me back at the PEWTER GYM. / There’s something I want to show / you about evolution.
Ah, BROCK’s back from MT. MOON! / Looks like your fossil hunting / gave him something to think about. / Want some advice before you / challenge him?
All right! / Let’s dig deep!
BROCK uses ROCK-type POKéMON. / They resist NORMAL and FIRE. / Don’t rely on brute force. / WATER and GRASS moves are / especially effective. / GROUND moves can also / break through their defense.

You stayed sure-footed!

You hit harder!

ROCK TUNNEL
POKéMON fight! / Ready, go!
Game over! / The tunnel swallowed my strategy.
I draw illustrations of POKéMON / when I’m home.
Whew… / I’m exhausted…
Um… Do you know about POKéMON / cosplay?
Well, that’s that.
My POKéMON techniques will leave / you crying!
I give! / You’re a better technician!
This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
Doh! / You handled the tunnel better than / I did!

Oh, hey! / You’re all the way out here, too? / The POWER PLANT’s been having / wild electrical surges lately. / I think underground currents in / ROCK TUNNEL are feeding into it. / There’s a POWER STATION up ahead, / but this tunnel splits around it. / Could you scout ahead and tell me / which direction I should take?
Which way should I take from here?
LEFT? / Got it! I’ll test that current.
No good! / The current that way is too strong. / It loops back on itself. / Which way should I try?
Which way should I take from here?
RIGHT? / All right, I’ll follow that flow.
Thanks for guiding me here! / I’ve got this generator stable / again. / But there are more surges ahead. / I’m going to follow the current.
I can hear you through the wall! / There’s a waterfall ahead, and I / can see the current branching. / Could you scout for me again and / tell me which way to take?
Which way should I take from here?
RIGHT? / Got it! I’ll check that branch.
That steadied another surge! / There’s still one more current / pulling deeper into the tunnel. / I’m going to follow the opening / and see where it branches.
There you are! / This exit leads past the second / generator’s current. / I just need to reach the last / generator now. / Which way should I take?
LEFT? / Got it! I’ll follow that path.

That’s it! / The POWER PLANT is fixed, and / the currents are calm again. / All this work brought positive / change to ROCK TUNNEL. / I’m heading back to the GYM. / Come find me there, okay? / I’ve got something interesting / about evolution to show you.
The climb to ROCK TUNNEL is my / training ground! / Keep your stance low and steady!
I lost my stance!
MISTY’s back from ROCK TUNNEL! / Sounds like guiding her through / those currents helped settle / something big. / Want some advice before you / challenge her?
All right! / Let’s make waves!

Yo! / Champ in the making! / Let me give you some advice! / The LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who / uses WATER-type POKéMON. / You can drain all their water with / GRASS-type POKéMON. / Or, you might use ELECTRIC-type / POKéMON and zap them!

Hey! You made it back! / Thanks for guiding me through / ROCK TUNNEL’s currents. / The POWER PLANT is stable again, / and I learned a lot watching how / you handled the flow. / Water is beautiful because it / changes without losing itself. / Now it’s time for an official / GYM challenge. / My policy is an all-out offensive / with WATER-type POKéMON!ÎカÀ
